A bill for an act relating to education; establishing student eligibility for postsecondary enrollment options participation; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.09, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.09, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 5c.+]

[+Authorization; student eligibility.+]

[+(a) A postsecondary institution must establish eligibility criteria for pupils applying to enroll in a course under subdivision 5. The criteria must include: +]

[+(1) a minimum qualifying grade point average; +]

[+(2) performance on a standardized assessment, such as an 8th grade Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment or other standardized assessment used to assess student preparedness for college-level courses; and +]

[+(3) class rank. +]

[+(b) A postsecondary institution may allow a pupil who does not meet the eligibility criteria to enroll in a course under subdivision 5 if the pupil's enrolling district, charter school, or American Indian-controlled Tribal contract or grant school submits a letter recommending the pupil be permitted to enroll in a course for postsecondary credit. +]

[+(c) A pupil who enrolls in a course under this section and does not obtain a passing grade is ineligible to enroll in a course under this section for the following quarter or semester. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective July 1, 2026. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; establishing student eligibility for postsecondary enrollment options participation; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.09, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 124D.09, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 5c.

Authorization; student eligibility.

(a) A postsecondary institution must establish eligibility criteria for pupils applying to enroll in a course under subdivision 5. The criteria must include:

(1) a minimum qualifying grade point average;

(2) performance on a standardized assessment, such as an 8th grade Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment or other standardized assessment used to assess student preparedness for college-level courses; and

(3) class rank.

(b) A postsecondary institution may allow a pupil who does not meet the eligibility criteria to enroll in a course under subdivision 5 if the pupil's enrolling district, charter school, or American Indian-controlled Tribal contract or grant school submits a letter recommending the pupil be permitted to enroll in a course for postsecondary credit.

(c) A pupil who enrolls in a course under this section and does not obtain a passing grade is ineligible to enroll in a course under this section for the following quarter or semester.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2026.

(b) A postsecondary institution may allow a pupil who does not meet the eligibility criteria to enroll in a course under subdivision 5 if the pupil's enrolling district, charter school, or American Indian-controlled Tribal contract or grant school submits a letter recommending the pupil be permitted to enroll in a course for postsecondary credit.
(c) A pupil who enrolls in a course under this section and does not obtain a passing grade is ineligible to enroll in a course under this section for the following quarter or semester.
